description: This file contains Express.js route handler functions for managing invoice data, including CRUD operations and querying invoices by user.

methods.name: getInvoicesByUser
methods.description: Fetches invoices created by a specific user based on search query.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of invoices created by a specific user.

methods.name: getInvoices
methods.description: Retrieves all invoices, sorted in descending order by ID.

methods.name: createInvoice
methods.description: Creates a new invoice document in the database.

methods.name: getInvoice
methods.description: Fetches a single invoice by its ID.

methods.name: updateInvoice
methods.description: Updates an existing invoice identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteInvoice
methods.description: Deletes an invoice by its ID.
